title: Configuration word congruence
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $C,D$ be configurations of $N$ on input $x$. For every $s\in\mathbb{N}$, if the configurations have the same core data and the same summary of their output words, then their encoded configuration words are equal.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
Equality of the configurations' core data together with their output summaries
